polozky.nadpis: WSGP — end of operation of version 2.10 services
polozky.perex: Users of the web services for authors and verifiers of survey sketches (WSGP): on 16 October 2026 the version 2.10 web services will be shut down.
polozky.telo: Dear users of the web services for authors and verifiers of survey sketches (WSGP), please note that on 16 October 2026 the operation of the version 2.10 web services for authors and verifiers of survey sketches will end. From that date only version 3.1 of the web service for authors and verifiers of survey sketches will be in operation. We apologise for any complications this causes and thank you for your understanding.

polozky.telo: New surveying system represents leap forward in field technology to maximize daily output and solve common challenges with confidence Munich and Westminster, Colo., Sept. 15, 2026 — Trimble today announced the launch of the Trimble ® ST30 smart target, a new-generation surveying system.
